branches.reason: This lens grounds the seven supplied NL contracts against exact source/PlantUML and closed FCSTM identities for case 0057 (Collision Avoidance). Key structural findings: (1) the top-level CA composite has three orthogonal sub-composites Frontend/RearEnd/Pedestrian, each an implicit single region, so 'three concurrent orthogonal regions' at the diagram top level is not realized by any separator/partition structure -- there is no orthogonal-region syntax at all, only three sibling composite substates; (2) CA's own initial edge targets a synthetic UnspecifiedInitial leaf with no outgoing transition rather than any of Frontend/RearEnd/Pedestrian, so the required activation entry into the collision-avoidance active mode is missing; (3) the root [*]->CA transition exists (S2 satisfied for outer entry into CA), but CA lacks any exact default entry into its collision-handling substates, which is a distinct initial_entry defect from the outer endpoint; (4) event consumer facts confirm all three detection events and the outer Possible_collision_detected event have zero reachable consumers, corroborating the region/entry contracts. Candidates are emitted for NL2-ENDPOINT-1 (transition_endpoints, refined into an initial-entry-style negative-fact framing given CA's actual owned initial edge), NL2-TRIGGER-1 (trigger_set, empty trigger on CA's owned entry edge), NL3-REGION-1 (region_structure, no orthogonal separator exists), and NL3-STATEACTION-1 (state_action/not_retained, predicate-null since concurrent activation cannot be expressed by S4).
